Incident Bot: Pager: Ingress gateway (edge-proxy) 5xx rate spike detected across US regions. Alert: 5xx_rate > 10% for 3m. Pager sent to @Alex (oncall)
Alex (oncall): seeing it, joining. Starting timeline.
Alex (oncall): @Priya can you confirm if any deploys around the time of spike?
Priya (eng-gateway): nope no deploys in last 30m on ingress, CI shows green. I'm pulling logs.
Marta (sre): I'm on metrics — Grafana dashboard shows a sharp jump in 502/504s at ~4200001100. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example.com/d/ingress/5xx-spike
Jay (support): getting a few customer reports about timeouts and 502s on /v1/generate endpoints. Not widespread yet but several paying customers in us-west reported errors.
Sara (product): high priority: any risk of data loss? Customers are retrying on their side which increases traffic — feature flags?
Priya (eng-gateway): no data loss. This is upstream failures — gateway unable to reach model backends. I see upstream 503/504 from pool nodes.
Alex (oncall): paste logs snippet please
Priya (eng-gateway): ```
[2026-03-15T12:02:01Z] edge-proxy: upstream request failed host=gw-node-12:6443 error=connect timeout
[2026-03-15T12:02:03Z] edge-proxy: returning 502 to client path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-15T12:03:45Z] edge-proxy: upstream 504 from model-pool-3 host=10.12.8.21
```
Marta (sre): Nginx/Envoy timeouts or upstream saturation? Check connection counts & open file descriptors on backend hosts.
Priya (eng-gateway): connection_count on model-pool-3 is high. Also seeing spikes in request queue length. Possibly slow downstream processing (KV cache thrash?).
Alex (oncall): roll mitigation plan: 1) temporarily enable circuit-breaker (reduce concurrent connections to pool-3), 2) add fallback routing to regional pool (us-east), 3) scale up pool-3 if autoscaler is healthy.
Priya (eng-gateway): executing step 1: updating envoy weight for cluster model-pool-3 to 0.3 and enabling max connections 50. Command: ```curl -s -X POST http://envoy-admin.local/clusters/model-pool-3/modify -d '{"max_conns":50,"weight":30}'```
Deploy Bot: envoy config change applied to edge-proxy-1 and edge-proxy-2 (revision 512). No errors.
Marta (sre): stepping through metrics — 5xx rate dipping on edge-proxy-1 but still high on edge-proxy-2. Might be an unhealthy host in that region.
Priya (eng-gateway): running quick healthcheck on pool hosts: ```for h in $(cat pool3-hosts); do curl -m2 http://$h/health || echo fail:$h; done``` got fail:10.12.8.21 and fail:10.12.8.23
Alex (oncall): mark those hosts out, drain and restart pods. Priya, can you drain 10.12.8.21 and 10.12.8.23?
Priya (eng-gateway): draining now: ```kubectl drain node/model-pool-3-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data; kubectl delete pod model-backend-21```
Jay (support): notifying customers: posting status note that we're investigating increased 502/504 errors, recommendation to retry with backoff. I'll update the status page.
Sara (product): note customers impacted: billing-sensitive workflows across a subset of customers in us-west. Flagging to CS to prioritize callbacks.
Marta (sre): after draining two hosts 5xx count dropped by ~60% on region us-west. Global 5xx rate back to ~2.1% within 6m.
Alex (oncall): good. Next steps: investigate root cause — why did pool hosts get saturated? Investigate request pattern (large batch bursts?), memory pressure, and kernel TCP queues. Priya please collect pprof/heap and tcpdump from drained hosts before recycle.
Priya (eng-gateway): collecting artifacts now, will upload to /artifacts/incidents/4200001234/ and include heap/profile + tcpdump + envoy stats.
Deploy Bot: autoscaler recommended adding 3 replicas to model-pool-3; autoscale triggered +3 -> replicas from 6 to 9.
Marta (sre): enabling temporary regional fallback rule: route 20% traffic from us-west to us-east until further notice. Adding rule via traffic manager.
Alex (oncall): handoff plan: I'm staying on for post-mortem triage. Priya & Marta will keep monitoring for 30m. Sara please coordinate customer comms. Jay keep support triage updated.
Jay (support): status page updated: https://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/4200001234 — brief, we're investigating 502/504s, workarounds applied.
Sara (product): will schedule high-priority postmortem and impact assessment doc.
Priya (eng-gateway): all good for now — 5xx at baseline, ingest latency normalized. I'll keep logs streaming for another 30m.
Alex (oncall): closing the immediate pager — we've mitigated visible symptoms. Creating incident ticket with notes and artifacts: INC-4200001234. Please attach logs and timeline.
Incident Bot: Pager resolved: Alert auto-resolved after 15m.
Marta (sre): follow-up actions: 1) deeper analysis of cache eviction patterns 2) verify autoscaler thresholds and headroom 3) run load test to reproduce. I created tasks in the incident board.
Jay (support): will reach out to impacted customers with timeline and credits if needed.
Priya (eng-gateway): uploading artifacts now. Link: https://internal-files.redwood.example.com/4200001234/archive.zip
Alex (oncall): thanks all. If anything spikes again ping #eng-oncall and call.
Sara (product): adding exec summary for stakeholders later today.
Alex (oncall): signing off for now.
